mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, reducing escitalopram metabolism and increasing plasma concentrations; additive CNS depression and potential serotonergic effects.
action: Monitor for increased escitalopram side effects (QT prolongation, serotonin syndrome symptoms); consider dose reduction of escitalopram or use alternative antidepressant; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
